slice_contract.problem: model=auto 在 canonical Runtime 创建前额外发送一次 non-streaming deepseek-v4-flash Chat 请求，并从首条任务文本、空 recent_context、关键词和 500 字阈值同时猜 model 与 thinking。它消耗 root/children 共用物理 request ledger、增加时延和 crash-before-RunCreated 的 unknown-billing 窗口，却没有相对固定 Pro 的 verified-success 非劣证据；随后所有 child 又无条件继承 root 选择。
acceptance: crates/app 是唯一 production Auto policy owner；crates/deepseek 只保留官方模型 capability、planner、transport/parser/accounting
显式 deepseek-v4-pro/deepseek-v4-flash 和显式 reasoning 保持原值，不经过 Auto policy

每个 RunRequest 的 model/reasoning 在 run 内 immutable；无 mid-run switch、隐式 Writer、multi-Writer、第二 Runtime/Store/backend/provider
RunStore 持久化 requested model mode、requested reasoning、policy version、selected model/reasoning、actor/workspace authority 和稳定 reason code，重开不重新路由

root/read-only/Writer、CLI/TUI/API、request ledger、SIGKILL/reopen 与 terminal accounting conformance 通过

candidate_policy.principle: Pro 负责，Flash 调查，Host 验证
candidate_policy.root_flash: not_admitted because current Run API has no typed bounded-low-risk product fact

hard_quality_gates: verified success is formally non-inferior to fixed Pro
no new Pro-only success in security/release/recovery/Writer strata
root/read-only/Writer evidence completion, replay and billing do not regress
all classifier/retry/recheck requests, tokens, time and cost are counted
formal_ab.efficiency_gate_after_quality: total cost or wall time improves by approximately 20 percent with positive code-complexity delta
formal_ab.credential_gate: Do not read key.txt or call the official API unless all four variants have a real frozen surface delta, one immutable identity and complete billing.
formal_ab.failure_decision: Keep explicit models; product default remains fixed Pro; Flash remains explicit and may be used for safely aggregated read-only child investigation.

non_conclusions: Flash read-only child quality is not assumed from model branding.
Removing one classifier request is mechanism evidence, not a verified task-success or cost claim.
No default Auto admission occurs before the formal quality and efficiency gates pass.
No local learned router, cascade or step-level model switch is part of this V1 slice.
